description: A stylized, heart-shaped television with a bright blue screen and two red antennae protruding from the top. The television has a glossy red casing that forms the heart shape, with a small, rectangular base. The overall design is playful and retro, resembling a cartoonish representation of a television set. The blue screen appears to be lit, suggesting it's either on or has a glowing quality. The object is presented in a somewhat blurred, indoor environment with patterned flooring and architectural elements in the background, suggesting it might be a prop or a decorative item.
